rule: D52c rule 4, D52's rule 4 (the owner's counting rule): each page template under "Coded records only", translated by this tree's page translator with no options (the index anchor as a hidden step; profile 1.3, the joint profile for Tree and Graph), narrowed by index_hull.py and simplified by index_simplify.py, pooled over the declared seeds: at least 30 patients with a window sent and a store candidate, and at most 30% of the distinct child types (PLAN keys; C001 is reference) with a candidate unresolved (a type is unresolved when any of its candidates is); none of the five refused. Reported: all candidates and the count without C001; the templates under stated findings with the same bar; D49's translation (indexAnchor false) on the same seeds; the Event frequency template under the 3rd seizure for 12 months

setting.window: from the first seizure, 24 months (the page's own)
setting.free_text: off (Coded records only), ruled; present (stated findings), reported
setting.translator: trajectory/store_request.js as committed (STORE_INDEX_ANCHOR true), no options; beside it the same with indexAnchor false (D49's request)
setting.store: store_parity.py build; index_hull.py narrow; index_simplify.py simplify; store_parity.py match (store_conditions.match)

independence: not independent children (D36 review, M1): C001 is the scripted reference child in every seed, and every other child takes archetype, sex, birth year and overrides from the generator's fixed PLAN; only the draws vary with the seed
